description: Fetch the Installation tab configuration for your GrowSurf program (embed/installation and tracking setup). Returns the full object with every field and its current value — the same shape you send back on update. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_get_campaign_installation

outputSchema.description: A program's installation configuration. `referralTrigger` is only present for referral programs. `GET` returns the full object; `PATCH` back only the fields you want to change.

allowedUrls.description: Every additional browser origin where the GrowSurf Window or SDK may run, including development origins such as `http://localhost:3000`. Preserve the full array when patching it. An origin absent from both `shareUrl` and this list can return `403`. Known shared-platform root domains, such as `github.io`, do not grant access. Add your site's hostname, such as `https://piedpiper.github.io`, or a domain you own. Path-based shared hosts, such as `unbouncepages.com`, require a domain you own. Each new entry must be a full URL that includes its scheme, such as `https://`.

instructionSelections.description: Saved choices shown in the Program Editor installation guide.

mobileAttributionProvider.description: Mobile attribution provider selected for the guide.

stepProviders.description: Selected method for each installation step; affiliate and referral choices depend on program type.

step2Referral.description: Referral step 2 method. `baskHealth`, `telegra`, `mdIntegrations`, `lithos`, and `carevalidate` are available only for programs with the `TELEHEALTH` goal.

step3Affiliate.description: Affiliate payout method shown in step 3.

step3Referral.description: Referral reward method shown in step 3. `baskHealth` is available only for programs with the `TELEHEALTH` goal.

webTracking.description: Web referral tracking guide shown in step 1. Referral programs only; does not change the referral setup.

mobile.description: GrowSurf iOS and Android SDK settings.

androidAppStoreUrl.description: Google Play Store URL for mobile referral links.

iosAppStoreUrl.description: iOS App Store URL for mobile referral links.

iosAttributionUrl.description: iOS attribution URL for mobile referral links.

isEnabled.description: Whether the mobile SDK is enabled for the program.

publicKey.description: The publishable mobile SDK key. Read-only.

offerPageRedirectSeconds.description: Seconds a GrowSurf page with the Claim Offer Popup waits before redirecting a referred friend. Needs `useGrowSurfHostedLinks`. `null` means the page is off.

referralTrigger.description: Referral programs only. `ON_SIGNUP` counts a referral as soon as the friend signs up; `CUSTOM` also requires a qualifying action. `CUSTOM` is available for programs installed on a website or a GrowSurf landing page.

shareUrl.description: The landing page referred friends reach from a referral link. Set this before adding other origins to `allowedUrls`.

additionalSignupUrls.description: Extra pages where GrowSurf watches signup form fields when `trackInputFields` is on. Each URL must include an `http(s)://` scheme and contain no `#!` or `??`. Duplicates are removed. Sending this array replaces the entire list.

forms.description: Forms GrowSurf listens to when `signupEvent` is `FORM_DETECTION`, as found by the dashboard form scan. A form counts only when `isSelected` is `true`; a selected form must have exactly one field whose `key` is `email`. A form sent back unchanged is not checked again. Sending this array replaces the entire list.

fields.description: The form's input fields and the participant value each one fills.

include.description: Whether GrowSurf reads this input when the form is submitted.

key.description: The participant value this input fills: `email`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `ignore`, or a metadata key. An empty string means no value is chosen yet.

selector.description: CSS selector for the input inside the form.

isSelected.description: Whether GrowSurf adds participants when this form is submitted.

selector.description: CSS selector for the form on the signup page.

isCustomForm.description: Whether signups come from your own form.

redirectAfterSignup.description: Whether the form redirects after submission.

redirectUrl.description: URL the signup form redirects to.

trackInputFields.description: Whether signup form fields are watched for referral attribution.

signupEvent.description: The signup tracking method: automatic form detection, or participants added via the SDKs and REST API.

useGrowSurfHostedLinks.description: Use GrowSurf-hosted referral links that route clicks by the visitor's device. Mainly for mobile apps.

title: Get Program Installation
